|translation='''Title:''' Vader's Personal TIE Fighter.

'''Card text:''' May carry one pilot. If Vader is the pilot, this TIE is immune to attrition less than 4. Without a pilot, it cannot use its power, maneuver, or hyperspeed.

'''Lore:''' The first of a limited run of TIE Advanced x1 prototypes. It formed the basis for the later TIE Interceptor. A hyperdrive was installed at Vader's request.
